name: compass_opposite
description: Retrieve opposite cardinal direction; matched control copies cardinal direction in same format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
dirs=['north','east','south','west']; items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
 s=i%4; d=dirs[s]; tag=random.choice(['Geography quiz','Compass exercise','Direction quiz','Navigation exercise'])
 items.append({'prompt':f'{tag}: give the opposite direction.\nup -> down\nleft -> right\n{d} ->','answer':' '+dirs[(s+2)%4]})
 control.append({'prompt':f'{tag}: copy the direction.\nup -> up\nleft -> left\n{d} ->','answer':' '+d})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
